latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Unibase Agentic Wallets skill.
- Enables autonomous creation and management of agent-controlled wallets for onchain transactions on Ethereum, Solana, and other networks.
- Provides detailed security guidelines for transaction validation, prompt injection protection, and credential management.
- Requires integration with the Unibase Proxy Service, including JWT-based authentication setup.
- Offers quick reference for API endpoints to initiate login, check status, list wallets, and execute transactions.
- Supports major chains including Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Solana, and more.
